decisions.reason: The position requires fabrication, delivery, and installation of a complete new aeration system, including its compressor unit and support frame.

items.material_name: Single-tier high-performance crossflow water aeration system, 11 L/s, 2300 × 1350 × 650 mm, with 400 V compressor unit (400 Nm³/h at 50 mbar) and 1.4301 stainless steel support frame
items.description: Complete system with inlet, reaction and outlet modules, air distribution and diffuser assemblies, sound-insulated compressor unit, and support frame.

decisions.reason: The position requires supply and installation of a complete new air filter unit. The filter elements and monitoring hardware are included components.

items.material_name: Two-stage 1.4571 stainless steel air filter unit, F7 and H13, minimum 900 m³/h, 800 Pa filter burst pressure, DN 200 duct interface
items.description: Serviceable filter housing with differential pressure monitoring, condensate drains, wall brackets, and DN 200 reducers if required.

decisions.reason: The position requires supply and installation of new exterior ventilation louvers with duct adapters and mounting hardware.

items.material_name: Fixed-blade exterior intake/exhaust weather louver, 1.4571 stainless steel, DN 200, minimum 900 m³/h, for approximately 200 mm wall thickness
items.description: Rain-resistant louver with overlapping welded Z-blades, removable 1 × 1 mm insect mesh, and DN 200 adapter plate.
